definitions.wallet_relative_zero_wallet_rule: zero wallet counts as low contribution; report separately
definitions.uncapped_score: diagnostic only, unbounded, not proposed as a replacement
definitions.conditional_blue: 60% if previous group mean contribution >=30 or first round, otherwise 10%
definitions.policy_amounts: use observed own wallet rounded to two decimals, as in original observations
definitions.policy_cap_mode: 100-unit contribution cap imposed on policy requests only; same engine
definitions.punishment_heavy_blue: punish matched Red 15 if its last contribution <10, else contribute 60%
definitions.red_punish: severity50 against matched Blue every round, skipped if unaffordable
